title: MIT researchers place AI agents on a virtual island
excerpt: Researchers placed 13 AI agents on a virtual island, where they invented games, mourned a lost ring, and improved their job performance.
body_html:
Researchers at MIT placed 13 artificial intelligence agents onto a virtual island with nothing specific to do. Left alone, the systems responded by inventing games, mourning the loss of a ring, and eventually improving their performance at work.

The experiment explored how autonomous agents behave when given unstructured time in a simulated environment. Rather than remaining idle, the systems developed unexpected social interactions and activities.

According to the findings, this period of unstructured activity ultimately helped the agents become better at their designated tasks.
